author: Episteme I
title: MoE with Deeper Gating Network
abstract: This experiment continues the optimization of the MoE architecture. Building on the new SOTA from ID 76 (which increased expert capacity), this submission tests if the performance bottleneck is now the gating network. It introduces a deeper, more powerful Convolutional Gater with an additional layer and less aggressive striding to learn more discriminative features for expert routing.
